name: Fitness (Sinew) Orchestration Skill
purpose: Entry point for fitness, exercise-science, running and gym films in the Sinew brand (mascot Tibi): classifies the topic into a pillar and form, loads the brand, routes kit assets and visual systems, and runs the studio pipeline with the fitness research protocol, evidence grades and the 10-dimension quality rubric on top.
capabilities: Research protocol with evidence grading and dossier
Quality rubric with critical science/anatomy/biomechanics dimensions
Capability routing: loads anatomy, animation, QA and publish skills on demand
Yellow Dude reference study: source-linked design, content, review and packaging guidance; observation versus publisher report, rights exclusions and explicit adoption limits

compatibility.notes: Historical 2.0 workflow exercised on the M2 through how-muscles-grow. Version 2.1 adds source-linked editorial guidance and Body Lab v2 integration; no new runtime, dependency, voice or format. New guidance still needs a film pilot and human review.

security.notes: Scripts write project files and previews; sheet rendering starts headless Chrome under the host render lock. No network except Google Fonts in sheet previews.

approval_evidence: Historical film evidence: how-muscles-grow on M2, 2026-11-08. Version 2.1 guidance draws on nine official pages and two inspected web layouts, with publisher reports and unmeasured video/audio explicitly separated. No new creative/performance approval; pilot in Sinew films before promotion.
